Title: ED 100 / ED 250 Radar Sensor M A01: Setup & Error Codes
Author: leo lu
Body HTML:
The Radar Sensor M A01 is the dedicated activation sensor for the ED 100 and ED 250 swing door operators: it detects approaching people, lets the control unit calculate the ideal opening time, and — thanks to targeted cross-traffic detection — keeps the door closed when people merely walk past. This guide condenses the official quick guide (060616-45532, 06/2024): mounting positions, DIP switches, CAN wiring, commissioning parameters and the complete LED error-code table.

Compatibility requirement: the M A01 is designed exclusively for ED 100/250 operators with firmware V2.9 or higher. All work described here may only be carried out by qualified electricians.

1. Technical data

Parameter Value
Supply voltage 24 V DC ±15%
Power consumption < 2.5 W
Operating temperature −20 °C to +55 °C
Rel. humidity up to 95%, non-condensing
Protection class IP54
Mounting height 2.0–4.0 m
Transmission frequency 24.050–24.250 GHz
Transmission power < 20 dBm
Detection speed min. 0.1 m/s
Detection area approx. 10 m

Compliance: Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, EMC 2014/30/EU, Radio Equipment 2014/53/EU, RoHS 2011/65/EU; EN 16005:2013, EN 300 440, EN 301 489-1/-3, EN 62368-1 — plus UKCA for the UK market.

2. Mounting positions and heights

# Parameter Value
1 Installation height from the floor 2.0–4.0 m
2 Height above the door leaf upper edge (central mounting, recommended) 0.2–0.5 m
3 Recommended positions max. 0.8 m displacement from center permitted; 1-leaf: exactly centered above the leaf; 2-leaf: exactly centered above both leaves
4 Optional positions mounting at operator height above the hinges is permitted (preferably on the active leaf for 2-leaf doors) — note: on 2-leaf doors this increasingly leads to false alarms
Avoid shadowing: the ED operator housing must not block the sensor's field of view. Determine positions on both the hinge side and the opposite side centrally above the door.

3. DIP switch settings (before wall mounting)

Set the DIP switches before mounting the sensor on the wall, and observe ESD protective measures. If the DIP positions are changed later, a CAN reset (Cr = 1) is mandatory.

DIP ON OFF
1 outside detector inside detector
2 opposite side to the hinge hinge side
3 option option
4 CAN terminating resistor active — set on the last participant in the bus series terminating resistor inactive

4. Wiring and tilt angle

Connection terminals (color code): white = +24 V DC · green = CAN-H · yellow = CAN-L · brown = GND.

Critical: the M A01 connects to the CAN 1 terminal on the ED connection board CAN. The CAN 2 terminal is not compatible with the radar sensor — CAN 1 and CAN 2 are not interchangeable.
Mounting height 2.0 m 2.5 m 3.0 m 3.5 m 4.0 m
Recommended tilt angle (15° steps) 30° 30° 45° 45° 45°

For intermediate heights, use the tilt angle of the next higher or lower mounting height. In special cases (e.g. a wall inside the detection area) the angle may be adjusted. On 2-leaf doors, the ED connection board CAN goes into the active leaf operator.

5. Commissioning and parameters

Parameters are set via the handheld device ("Special functions" menu) or the ED's user interface. The CAN reset parameter is only available on the ED's user interface.

Trigger a CAN reset (Cr = 1) whenever: initial commissioning after all devices are connected · a device was added to the bus · a device was replaced · DIP switches were adjusted · the control unit no longer recognizes the CAN devices. The parameter resets itself to 0 afterwards. Note: with at least one M A01 connected, the CAN reset automatically sets the hold-open time dd to "0" (changeable afterwards). After a factory reset of the ED, all parameters — including C1 and the sensor parameters — must be set again.
Parameter Range Default Function
Cross-traffic mode inside / outside (MA01 IM QV / AM QV) 0–3 0 0 = hide cross-traffic left & right · 1 = capture right · 2 = capture left · 3 = capture both sides
Mounting height inside / outside (Ih / Ah) 20–40 25 sensor mounting height in 100 mm increments
Door opening time inside / outside (IT / AT) 0–6 3 0 = very early … 6 = very late; smaller values weaken cross-traffic suppression — the door opens more sensitively
So (opening speed) — — affects the general opening time: slower opening = door opens sooner; faster = opens later

6. Troubleshooting: the 7 LED error codes

The RGB LED on the ED connection board CAN indicates errors by its number of flashes; the highest-priority message is shown. Process data between the ED control unit and the radar sensor is not exchanged while an error is active.

No. Error Cause Fix
1 TMS communication error communication between ED control unit and ED connection board CAN interrupted check C1 parameter setting and the connection cable; if applicable reset the operator power supply
2 CAN initialization error sensor address assignment failed — expected responses not received check CAN cable and bus termination (DIP 4 = ON on the last participant); perform CAN reset
3 Unknown CAN bus participant unknown devices detected or max. number of participants exceeded check connected devices, remove incorrect ones from the bus; execute CAN reset
4 Device assignment error device positions appear twice in the assignment check DIP switch settings on the radar sensors; execute CAN reset
5 Missing device error a trained radar sensor is no longer available after switch-on check CAN cable and the device; if applicable reset the operator power supply
6 CAN communication error communication between radar sensor and ED connection board CAN interrupted check CAN cable; if applicable reset the operator power supply
7 Radar sensor error sensor sends an emergency message due to an internal error reset the ED operator power supply

Compatible sensors and CAN accessories for ED 100 / ED 250

DoorDynamic supplies OEM-compatible radar sensors, ED connection boards CAN, cables and accessories compatible with the dormakaba ED 100 and ED 250 — verified for firmware V2.9+ systems, with fast shipping to Europe and the Middle East. Tell us your error code or mounting situation, and we will help you identify the right part.

Title: ES PROLINE Sliding Door Operators: Technical Guide
Author: leo lu
Body HTML:
Product family overview · Based on the official technical product brochure (EN, 01/2026)

ES PROLINE is the current generation of automatic sliding door operators in the dormakaba portfolio: a modular drive platform covering standard sliding doors, escape-route doors (FST) and telescopic sliding doors, with door leaf weights up to 2 × 250 kg and a service life verified over 1.5 million opening/closing cycles — around 50% longer than the previous generation. This guide condenses the 28-page technical brochure into the tables and decision points that specifiers, installers and maintenance contractors actually need.

1. The three product lines at a glance

Line Positioning Max. door leaf weight Expansion modules
ES PROLINE EASY Entry-level solution with Direct Drive Unit (DDU) 1 × 125 kg / 2 × 125 kg (telescopic: 2 × 75 / 4 × 75 kg) Not extendable
ES PROLINE (PRO) Standard sliding doors, full function set up to 1 × 400 kg / 2 × 250 kg (ES 500 PRO) Optional (4 I/O, SiAK, MS)
ES PROLINE FST Sliding doors on escape and rescue routes up to 2 × 200 kg Optional; battery set supplied as standard

Drive designations: ES 250 PRO, ES 400 PRO, ES 500 PRO for standard doors; a T suffix marks telescopic versions (ES 250 PRO T, ES 400 PRO T); FST marks the escape-route function. Existing ES 200 systems can be converted to the ES PROLINE platform.

2. Why the platform was redesigned

  • Powerful — dormakaba Direct Drive motor technology for dynamic opening and closing; the ES 500 PRO moves double leaves of 2 × 250 kg.
  • Durable — type-tested over 1.5 million cycles, extending door service life by ~50%.
  • Quick — opening speeds up to 90 cm/s (model-dependent) keep pedestrian flow smooth and reduce energy loss through open doors.
  • Quiet — gearless motor design for noise-sensitive applications (healthcare, hotels, offices).
  • Connected — optional Door Pilot Bluetooth interface enables app control and status monitoring from a smartphone.
  • Sustainable — 100% recyclable packaging; Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) according to ISO 14025.

3. Standard sliding doors: dimensions and weights

Parameter ES 250 PRO / EASY ES 400 PRO ES 500 PRO ES 250/400 PRO FST
Max. leaf weight (1-leaf) 1 × 125 kg 1 × 250 kg — —
Max. leaf weight (2-leaf) 2 × 125 kg 2 × 200 kg 2 × 250 kg per FST rating
Clear passage width LW 700–3,000 mm 850–3,000 mm 800–3,000 mm 1,650–3,000 mm
Clear passage height LH 2,000–3,000 mm

Operator height / depth 100 / 180 mm 100 / 180 mm 150 / 180 mm 100 / 180 mm
Escape-route rule: sliding doors on escape routes are only approved when installed with type-approved dormakaba profile systems. The minimum clear passage width is defined by regional building codes.

Estimating leaf weight: leaf weight = LH [m] × LW [m] × glass weight [kg/m²]. Reference values: 10 mm toughened safety glass ≈ 25 kg/m²; 12 mm insulating glass ≈ 30 kg/m².

4. Technical data (standard & telescopic operators)

5. Telescopic versions for wide passages

Telescopic operators (T) create wide clear openings with slim system widths — up to 4,000 mm passage width on 4-leaf escape-route doors:

Min. operator length 1.5 × LW + 100 mm

Guide-rail suspension: an additional suspension of the guide rail is required from a leaf weight of 2 × 75 kg / 4 × 75 kg, and strongly recommended from 3 m opening width.

6. Locking devices

Locking device Function Use case
Magnetic locking device (FIA) Jam-free; locks the door in all automatic program switch positions even with persons inside; type-approved by the German Technical Inspectorate (no individual approval needed) Escape-route doors in 24/7 buildings: banks' self-service areas, hotels, hospitals, schools
Electro-mechanical belt locking device Self-adjusting, mounted directly on the drive unit; lock status signal contacts as standard; bistable ex works — monostable Failsafe / Failsecure versions available Standard sliding doors requiring reliable locking
Electromotive hook locking device Multipoint locking with five motor-driven swing bolts; optional mechanical manual release Anti-intruder doors up to resistance class RC2 / RC3 (standard on RC doors)
Escape-route restriction: for all mechanical locks on escape and rescue route doors, locking is only permitted when no persons are in the building.

7. Casing variants

  • Standard casing — heights 100 mm and 150 mm; cover bracket supplied as standard, opens in three positions.
  • Integrated casing — conceals the operator in suspended ceilings; the cover detaches from below for maintenance; accessory sets integrate the safety sensors into the cover so the full passage height stays usable.
  • Sensor casing — premium look for 100 mm drive heights; activation and safety sensors integrated into the drive system with no visible add-on units; approved for clear passage heights up to 3,000 mm.

8. Master controller functions & expansion modules

The PRO master controller already implements a wide function set without any additional hardware:

Function What it does PRO PRO FST PRO EASY

Night/bank function Access control or key switch active with program switch in "Off": unlock – open – close – lock ● ● ●

Optional expansion modules (PRO / PRO FST only):

  • 4 I/O module — four programmable inputs + four outputs when the master controller connections are already assigned (one module at a time).
  • SiAK module — connects conventional (non-CAN) safety and activation sensors; MCE and SCE monitoring each require one module (two for both).
  • MS module — connects a conventional, non-CAN program switch.

9. Door Pilot App & CAN-bus wiring

With the optional Bluetooth Door Pilot interface, the Door Pilot app (iOS / Android) complements the mechanical program switch: six functions (Automatic, Partial opening, Exit, Permanent open, Off, Open-once) plus live door status (System OK / Maintenance due / Fault detected) — no building-network integration required.

On the wiring side, the platform supports both topologies:

  • CAN-bus: CAN sensors, CAN program switch, CAN emergency switch, CAN key switch and access control on the bus; sensor cables are delivered with the sensor.
  • Conventional: standard sensors, program switch and emergency switch via the SiAK / MS expansion modules.

Sensor accessories include ceiling installation sets, rain protection covers and fixing brackets for both 270 mm and 209 mm housing widths.

11. Standards and testing

  • Compliant with the Low Voltage Directive and the EMC Directive
  • Secondary closing-edge monitoring verified to DIN 18650 and EN 16005
  • Manufactured to ISO 9001
  • Environmental Product Declaration according to ISO 14025 (declaration holder: Institut Bauen und Umwelt e.V.)

Conclusion

ES PROLINE consolidates standard, escape-route and telescopic sliding doors onto one modular drive platform: Direct Drive power up to 2 × 250 kg, 1.5-million-cycle durability, CAN-bus connectivity with app control, and a complete accessory ecosystem from CleanSwitch to IXIO combined sensors. For retrofits, the ES 200 conversion path keeps upgrade projects economical.

Title: ES PROLINE for Installers: Fast Mounting & Commissioning
Author: leo lu
Body HTML:
If you install automatic sliding doors for a living, you know where the time goes: sorting ambiguous variant kits, carrying special tools, wiring and commissioning under time pressure. The ES PROLINE sliding door operator platform was designed around exactly these pain points — fewer modules, plug & play start-up, and one-person mounting. This guide summarises the official installer factsheet, covering system advantages, performance data and the full technical tables for standard, telescopic and escape-route versions.

For installers in one sentence: ES PROLINE reduces the number of modules, allocates product variants unambiguously, and can be installed by a single person without special tools — with commissioning via plug & play.

1. Advantages of the New Operator System

  • Reduced number of modules — non-ambiguous allocation of product variants means less time identifying the right kit on site.
  • Easy assembly, quick installation and commissioning — plug & play start-up shortens the time between delivery and handover.
  • One-person installation possible — no special tools required; one installer can handle the full mounting.
  • Construction-site-ready packaging — 100% recyclable packaging, with component parts delivered according to the stage of construction (track first, operator later if needed).
  • Smooth conversion of existing installations — upgrading an existing sliding door to ES PROLINE is possible without replacing the entire system.

2. The Benefits at a Glance

Strong

Door leaf weights of up to 400 kg can be implemented smoothly, thanks to the brushless direct drive motor.

Fast

Opening and closing speeds of up to 0.9 m/s — and still quiet in operation.

Modular

ES PROLINE can be configured in a modular way depending on project requirements.

Efficient

Direct drive motor combined with an energy-saving power supply unit for extremely efficient operation.

Durable

Tested and certified for 1.5 million opening and closing cycles.

Networked

The integral communication module allows status messages to be read out and the door to be controlled via an app.

3. Areas of Application
